summary_1line: Kusha and Lava sing Valmiki’s Ramayana before Rama and an assembly of sages and scholars, astonishing listeners with their music and resemblance to the king.

image_candidates.scene_text: Kusha and Lava, clad in bark garments with matted locks, play stringed instruments and sing before Rama and a vast assembly of sages and kings.
The gathered sages and citizens stare in amazement, whispering that the two young singers look exactly like Rama himself.
Rama sits among scholars and ascetics during the sacrifice, listening intently to the Ramayana being sung for the first time.
